builds.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast ceiling
builds.summary: Cannon helper Shock Blast gives (285+1.3 AD[statFormula=2])*1.4 through gate at rank 6. Armor penetration affects the entire empowered physical blast.
builds.goal: Cannon helper Shock Blast gives (285+1.3 AD[statFormula=2])*1.4 through gate at rank 6. Armor penetration affects the entire empowered physical blast.
builds.hypothesis:
Mercury Hammer: Jayce leaps to an enemy, dealing @spell.JayceToTheSkies:Damage@ physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by @spell.JayceToTheSkies:Slow*-100@% for @spell.JayceToTheSkies:SlowDuration@ seconds.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers. Cannon ShockBlast helper: (80/121/162/203/244/285+1.3 AD[statFormula=2])*1.4; source primary Q text above is hammer form, so use cannon helper for this objective.

builds.name: Thundering Blow: AD-scaling magic knockback
builds.summary: Investigate high one hammer-form Thundering Blow output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one hammer-form Thundering Blow output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The hammer E helper adds 1.0 bonus AD magic plus a rank-indexed fraction of enemy maximum HP; the raw rank-6 value is 22%. It has no direct AP coefficient. AD can improve a magic packet, so magic penetration competes with bonus AD rather than ordinary armor penetration.
